name: images-badge

frames.best_why: Frame 4 shows all three photos fanned widest above the open folder.

tagline: A small amber folder that fans three photos out over itself on hover.
summary: An inline folder icon with the label "View Photos". Hovering makes up to three little photos spring up and fan out above the folder, then fold away when the pointer leaves.
appearance: A small amber folder icon with a lighter tab, drawn at a tilt, sits beside the plain light grey label "View Photos" on a near-black stage. Hovered, three small rectangular photos rise out of the folder and fan out above it in a loose tilted spread.
behaviour: Hovering springs up to three photos upward and outward into a fanned stack, each with a tiny stagger, while the folder flap tilts flat beneath them. Leaving folds the photos back down behind the flap and restores the closed folder.
demo_content: "View Photos" beside shots of a blue sea, a grey street and a dusk skyline.
search_phrases: folder icon with photos popping out
hover to fan out image previews
folder that opens into a photo stack
hover reveal stacked photos from folder
use_when: A compact link should hint at a photo collection and reward a hover with a quick preview.
avoid_when: Only hover opens the photos, so touch and keyboard users just see a folder, and the images load from remote URLs.
customise: Text and the image list are props, with optional link target plus folder, teaser and hover sizes, lift, spread and rotation values.
weight_why: One small folder and up to three photo cards with a single hover spring.

a11y.note: The photo fan is hover-only, so keyboard and touch users never see it, and image alts are only "Preview 1" style labels.

issues: The photo fan is hover-only, so it stays folded for touch and keyboard users.
At rest the photos peek out only as thin slivers, so the preview reads mainly as a folder.
polish_why: Crisp folder icon and a neat photo spread; hover-only reveal and tiny resting previews hold it back.
title: Images Badge
